evals.prompt: Run the RSI mean reversion strategy on my paper account
evals.expected_output: Runs run_strategy.py with --account paper --strategy rsi_mean_reversion, checks market hours, evaluates exit conditions on open positions, scans watchlist for entry signals, places bracket orders if signals found
Runs dashboard.py on port 7432, opens http://localhost:7432, shows account cards with equity/P&L, equity curve chart, positions table with buy dates, and trade history

evals.prompt: Self-analyze my paper account performance for the last 30 days and update parameters if needed
evals.expected_output: Runs self_analyze.py --account paper --days 30, computes Sharpe/drawdown/win rate, applies adjustment rules if metrics are outside bounds, logs all changes with reasoning to analysis_log table

evals.prompt: How do I set up my Alpaca paper trading account?
evals.expected_output: Clear instructions to run setup.py, get API keys from app.alpaca.markets/paper/dashboard, enter key ID and secret, confirms connection and saves to DB, initializes default strategy params

evals.prompt: Backtest the RSI strategy on AAPL, MSFT, and SPY for the last 90 days
evals.expected_output: Runs backtest.py --symbols AAPL,MSFT,SPY --days 90, fetches historical bars from Alpaca, simulates bar-by-bar with position sizing and bracket orders, reports total return, win rate, profit factor, and recent trades
